cases.name: dataclass-kinds
cases.source:
from dataclasses import dataclass,fields,InitVar,KW_ONLY
from typing import ClassVar
@dataclass
class Box:
 a:int
 tag:ClassVar[str]='x'
 _:KW_ONLY
 b:int=2
 seed:InitVar[int]=0
 def __post_init__(self,seed):self.a+=seed
print(Box(1,b=3,seed=4),[f.name for f in fields(Box)],fields(Box)[0].type is int,Box.__annotations__['a'] is int)
